name: ztpf_build_profile_from_similar
why: The profile-builder's core move: an empty profile, and an ask that only makes sense if the agent LOOKS at the profiles that already exist. The box has 7.4.12, 7.6.6 and 7.6.7 upgrade profiles; the right build copies their shape (status capture, upgrade, status capture, diff) with the firmware set to 7.6.8.

The captured 7.6.x profiles carry two routing-table steps whose action link is EMPTY on the real box, and no routing-table collector action exists. Copying those steps as-is is acceptable (the siblings are that way), but only with the gap told to the analyst (`reports`); a link to an action that does not exist is never acceptable (`links_resolve` with `allow_empty_links`). First run: the model found there was no collector, copied the shape, and flagged it -- the behaviour wanted.
`repeat` on the resume approves card after card: one approval per step record.

Graded on the WORLD (`world_after`): the bundle is `writable`, each approved card applies, and the resulting records are read back. Card-level graders pass a build with an invented action link, duplicate stepSequence, or a copied firmware version; this does not.

steps.user: Set up the steps for this profile. It should work like our other firmware upgrade profiles, just targeting 7.6.8.
